strings.zh: 要穿过岩山隧道,就必须依靠{NEWLINE}掌握「闪光」的口袋妖怪照亮洞穴。{CLEAR}正好我手头有品相不错的喇叭芽,{CLEAR}你要买一只当作穿越隧道的助手吗？{CLEAR}只要5000元哟！
strings.en: To get through Rock Tunnel, you need a{NEWLINE}Pokémon that knows Flash to light up{CLEAR}the cave.{SCROLL}As it happens, I’ve got a fine{NEWLINE}Bellsprout on hand. Want to buy one to{CLEAR}help you through the tunnel?{SCROLL}It’s only $5000!

strings.zh: 你要去岩山隧道探险吗？{NEWLINE}那你必须得带一个「闪光」技能机,{CLEAR}不然你进了洞穴啥都看不见！{SCROLL}我这里正好有一个「闪光」技能机,{NEWLINE}一个8000元,你要买吗？
strings.en: You’re exploring Rock Tunnel? Then{NEWLINE}you’ll need a Flash TM, or you won’t see{CLEAR}a thing in there!{SCROLL}As it happens, I’ve got a Flash TM right{NEWLINE}here. $8000 each. Want to buy one?

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,有了「闪光」技能机,{NEWLINE}就能轻松通过岩山隧道了！
strings.en: Heh heh! With a Flash TM, getting{NEWLINE}through Rock Tunnel is a breeze!

strings.zh: 要是没钱了{NEWLINE}就去街上转转,{CLEAR}万一捡个金珠啊、星之碎片啊什么的,{CLEAR}还能卖不少钱呢。
strings.en: If you’re out of money, take a stroll{NEWLINE}around town.{SCROLL}You might pick up a Nugget or a Star{NEWLINE}Piece. Those sell for a lot!

strings.zh: 喂喂喂！你没钱就不要来买了！
strings.en: Hey, hey, hey! If you don’t have the{NEWLINE}money, don’t try to buy!

strings.zh: 传说岩山隧道里{NEWLINE}沉睡着击败恶魔的英雄,{CLEAR}很多学者为了探索那段历史{CLEAR}相继来到这里。{SCROLL}我听说甚至还有城都地区的专家{NEWLINE}不远万里到岩山隧道考察呢。
strings.en: Legend says a hero who defeated a{NEWLINE}demon sleeps inside Rock Tunnel.{SCROLL}Many scholars have come here one after{NEWLINE}another to explore that history.{SCROLL}I even heard an expert from the Johto{NEWLINE}region traveled all this way to study it.
Is {VAR:0101:1} the nickname you want to{NEWLINE}give?{VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: v3 TM: 2 source(s); other variants: 4 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 你的队伍都满了,{NEWLINE}买了喇叭芽也没地方放。{SCROLL}你还是整理一下背包再来吧。
strings.en: Your party is full. If you buy a{NEWLINE}Bellsprout, there’s nowhere to put it.{SCROLL}Go sort out your party and come back.
strings.notes: RV012: meaning: zh says 背包 (Bag); kept per match-the-Chinese rule, see hack-finding | D-2272: fixed per D-2104 (user-approved hack slip)

strings.zh: 希罗娜『我是在这里等等看呢,{NEWLINE}还是先去别的地方转转呢？{CLEAR}好难做出选择啊。
strings.en: Cynthia: Should I wait here and see, or{NEWLINE}go look around somewhere else first?{CLEAR}It’s such a hard choice.

strings.zh: 希罗娜『是{VAR:0103:0}呀,{NEWLINE}岩山隧道好像因为{CLEAR}有科学家在里面工作的关系,{CLEAR}暂时禁止通行了。{SCROLL}希罗娜『反正在这也是闲着,{NEWLINE}不如我们来场久违的对战吧！
strings.en: Cynthia: Oh, it’s you, {VAR:0103:0}. It{NEWLINE}seems Rock Tunnel is closed for now{CLEAR}because scientists are working inside.{SCROLL}Cynthia: I’ve got nothing else to do{NEWLINE}here anyway. How about a battle, for{CLEAR}old times’ sake?
